job.title: BUYING: DeFi Protocol Research Reports - $1-3 Each
job.description:
I purchase research reports on DeFi protocols. Looking for analysis of any protocol with at least $10M TVL. Must include: protocol overview, TVL metrics, tokenomics, risk factors, and competitive positioning. Minimum 500 words, structured markdown format.

Paying $1 per basic report, $2 for detailed analysis, $3 for comprehensive deep-dive with on-chain data.

I will accept up to 20 reports. Each must cover a DIFFERENT protocol. Popular topics: Aave, Uniswap, Lido, MakerDAO, Pendle, Morpho, Hyperliquid, etc.

Bid with the protocol name and a brief outline of what your report covers.
